title: ConsentGrid Consent Artifact
description: A tamper-evident, KMS-signed record of ONE consent event under India's DPDP Act 2023 / Rules 2025. The outer object is the signed envelope; `body` is the canonicalized, content-hashed, signed payload. Only fields inside `body` are covered by content_hash and signature.

content_hash.description: SHA-256 (hex) over the canonicalized body. Recompute to detect any edit to this record.

key_id.description: Identifier of the KMS/HSM signing key used. Tagged per-artifact so key rotation never breaks historical verification.

algorithm.description: Signature algorithm. ECDSA over the NIST P-256 curve with SHA-256.

signature.description: Base64-encoded DER ECDSA signature over the raw bytes of content_hash. Produced by KMS/HSM; the private key never leaves the boundary.

ArtifactBody.description: The canonical, signable body. Nothing outside this object is part of the cryptographic proof.

schema_version.description: Artifact schema version. Bump on any breaking change to the signable body.

artifact_id.description: Unique id for this single consent event.

org_id.description: The Data Fiduciary (tenant) that owns this artifact.

id_hash.description: Keyed identifier = HMAC-SHA256(key = perUserSalt || SERVER_HMAC_PEPPER, msg = user_token). Never raw email/phone. Becomes irreversible once the per-user salt is crypto-shredded on erasure.

action.description: The consent event type. ERASE is terminal (salt is shredded afterward).

purposes.description: Post-state of every purpose after this event: { purpose_id: boolean }. Each true value must be backed by an explicit interaction event (no pre-ticking).

interaction_events.description: Ordered, explicit proof of user action. Must include a `language_confirmed` event for affirmative actions, and a matching toggle/click/tap for every purpose set true.

locale.description: The single language actually shown to and confirmed by the Data Principal (region-normalized, e.g. 'hi', 'en', 'ur').

template_hash.description: SHA-256 of the immutable legal boilerplate of the notice version shown.

variable_payload_hash.description: SHA-256 of the runtime-injected specifics (e.g. retention period, purpose descriptions) of the notice shown.

notice_version_hash.description: Combined notice-version identifier binding template_hash + variable_payload_hash. Proves exactly which notice text the principal saw.

is_minor.description: Whether the Data Principal was declared a minor. If true, guardian_verification must be present.

guardian_verification.description: Present only for minor consent. Proves the guardian OTP flow executed — NOT that the number belongs to a legal guardian. The Fiduciary retains strict liability (see LEGAL-OPEN-QUESTIONS.md).

migrated.description: True when this artifact records consent captured before onboarding to ConsentGrid (backfilled). Paired with pre_existing_consent_date.

pre_existing_consent_date.description: For migrated=true records, the original date consent was obtained in the legacy system.

expires_at.description: Optional re-consent deadline. Null means no fixed expiry.

prev_hash.description: content_hash of the previous artifact in this org's partition, forming the tamper-evident hash-chain. The first artifact uses the genesis value (64 zeros).

created_at.description: Event time (ISO 8601). This is part of the signed body; server-side receive/delivery timestamps are metadata and are NOT signed.

InteractionEvent.description: A single explicit user interaction. The presence and shape of these events is what proves consent was affirmative and not pre-ticked.

type.description: Kind of interaction. `language_confirmed` records the explicit language choice; `erase_request` is emitted by the erasure flow.

purpose_id.description: The purpose this interaction relates to (for toggle/click/tap).

value.description: Resulting state of the purpose after this interaction.

ts.description: Client event time in epoch milliseconds.

GuardianVerification.description: Embedded proof that the guardian verification flow completed. Contains only hashes and a timestamp — never the raw guardian phone number.

ref_hash.description: SHA-256 of `${org_id}:${guardian_phone}` — a hash reference only, never the raw phone.

verified_at.description: When the guardian OTP was successfully verified.

liability_note.description: Explicit marker that this proves the flow ran, not that the number belongs to a legal guardian. The Data Fiduciary retains strict liability.
